tags.feature: - Addition of the dedicated card file tool [b]MONSTER CARDS BINDER[/b]
- Release of various DLC, including customization expansion and Skill Packs
- Balance adjustments to the [b]Fusion[/b] skill (revised attack power formula & limit of 3 Discards per turn)

[b]MONSTER CARDS BINDER[/b]
MONSTER CARDS BINDER is a brand-new card selection tool that replaces the “Explorer” and “Pseudo Card Binder.”
You can enable it by selecting MONSTER CARDS BINDER under the card selection tool option in the in-game settings.

[b]Tagging Feature[/b]
You can now assign up to three tags in the card settings screen.
These tags can be used as search keywords within the newly added MONSTER CARDS BINDER, and they will also be displayed in the flavor text section when zooming in on a card.
This makes it easier to highlight whether a card belongs to a specific series or category!

[b]Adjustments to Painting Tools
[/b]With the addition of new customization features included in the upcoming Customization Expansion DLC, several enhancements have been made to the in-game painting tools:
①・・・Presets for changing brush size
②・・・Option to adjust the opacity of the card frame
③・・・Sliders (from right to left): Scale, Vertical Move, Horizontal Move
Movement can also be controlled with the WASD keys or arrow keys
Scaling can also be controlled with the mouse scroll wheel, or by pressing Left Shift + W/S or Up/Down arrow keys
④・・・Toggle button for Borderless Layer (extended customization feature)
⑤・・・Background color layer
You can choose whether or not to display the background color layer during cut-in animations

[b]New Battle Option: “Discard Play Limit per Turn”[/b]
To prevent scenarios where activating Fusion multiple times in a single turn could lead to an overwhelming board state early in the game, we’ve added a new option to limit the number of times Discard can be played per turn.
By default, this is set to 3 times per turn, but it can be adjusted in the battle settings screen.
Note: This is an experimental balance adjustment related to the Fusion skill. We’ll continue to monitor player feedback and gameplay situations to refine the balance further.
[b]New Sample Cards[/b]

[b]Unlimited Rerolls[/b]
The number of rerolls during card creation becomes unlimited.
[i]Note: In Ver.0.20 the limit was 12, and in Ver.0.21 it has been raised to 20 even for players without the DLC.[/i]

[b]Borderless Layer[/b]
Allows illustrations to extend beyond the card frame.
This can be enabled/disabled for each layer via the checkbox next to the layer button.

[b]Live Motion[/b]
Adds effects to layers, allowing your artwork to be expressed more dynamically.
Motions are created by combining multiple animation presets.

[b]Fusion【Discard】[/b]
[b]New：[/b]Fuse Fusion Material 1 and Fusion Material 2 from your hand to create Fusion Form.
・Fusion materials must be of the same rarity.
・Fusion materials can be substituted with cards of the same stats but different names.
[b]・The fusion form has a base attack power of 2. If the fusion materials have skills, part of their attack power is inherited; if they don’t, most of the attack power is inherited.
[/b]・Skills from both materials are combined without duplication.

[b]Trick or Treat【Standard】[/b]
[b]New：At the start of your turn, if your opponent has cards in hand, force them to choose Trick or Treat.
Trick!: Take 1 damage.
Treat!: Hand over any card from their hand.[/b]
[b]New ULT：If your opponent has no cards in hand at the start of your turn, forcefully activate a trick.When this card successfully attacks, activate the other effect not chosen at the start of the turn.[/b]

[b]Trap【Discard】[/b]
[b]New ULT：Force your opponent to discard one random card from their hand.
If this card is discarded from your hand, apply the effect to the owner of the card in the offense zone.[/b]

tags.balance_change: Heal: Can now restore health to all allies.
Lightning: Now deals damage to all other players when played onto the field.
Pressure: Its influence over the field has been reduced, but it now applies a powerful effect to all players’ hands.
Reverse: Enhanced so that more can be recovered than before.
Surge: Improved to deal stronger and more consistent damage.
Evolve: The completed form is now added to your hand even in the case of a draw.
Wild Element: Cards of the unchosen attribute are now moved to your hand instead of your deck.
Trick or Treat: Adjusted in line with the skill effect changes.
Soldier: Some effects have been strengthened.

notes.title: April Fools' Event "Version Rewind Chaos" is now live!
notes.content:
[h2][b]You fight OP with OP!
A legendary broken skill returns, transcending time itself![/b][/h2]

[h1]Event Period[/h1]
[b]From Tuesday, April 1, 00:00 JST to Monday, April 14, 23:59 JST[/b]

[h1]Event Details[/h1]
During the event, the special battle mode "Version Rewind Chaos" will be available in the battle options!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/95863a2db89730ee4bcd1f56412e0a097be2f6cb.png[/img]

[h2]What is "Version Rewind Chaos"?[/h2]
A limited-time battle option where balance goes out the window, offering chaotic and exciting battles!
This mode has two main features:

[olist]
[h3][*] Skills revert to their effects from past versions![/h3]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/fe8df98b91da4453c144a619969dd4bdce7c2233.png[/img]
[b][h1]Introduction[/h1][/b]
Thank you for always enjoying MONSTER CARDS!
It has been over a year since the last update, and we are finally releasing a new version!
To everyone who has been patiently waiting, we truly appreciate your support.

This update mainly focuses on improvements to the "invisible parts" of the game to make it better in the long run.
However, we have also introduced SR skills and made balance adjustments to numerous skills, aiming to create a competitive environment where a diverse range of cards can shine.

We hope you continue to enjoy MONSTER CARDS!

[b]New Ver 0.19 Highlights[/b]

1. Addition of SP skills exclusive to SR rarity
2. Revamped EX card skills born from Ultimate Arts: "Challenge" and "Ultimate (EX)"
3. Restriction preventing Disturbed cards such as Poison and Curse from being used in battles
4. Improved machine translation accuracy for languages other than Japanese

For more detailed information, please check the link below. (Japanese only)
[url=https://gasai.dev/18d9053e8b3a802ca472d4a93aae86dd]MONSTER CARDS Ver.0.19 Patch Notes[/url]

[h1]New Features & Additions[/h1]
We have implemented additional effects similar to ULT for SR rarity skills.
Standard and GameChanger have the same effect across the board, while Discard skills have unique effects for each.

[list]
[*][h3]Addition of SP Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*]Standard (General)
SP: Skills cannot be sealed by effects such as barriers.
[*]GameChanger (General)
SP: Locks the GameChanger zone for the next turn.
[/list]
[b]【BASIC】[/b]
[list]
[*]Dodge【Discard】
SP: Can activate even if the attack power is 3 or lower.
[*]Reverse【Discard】
SP: Heals all players by 1 and draws one card.
[*]Snipe【Discard】
SP: Draws an additional card.
[/list]
[b]【Advanced】[/b]
[list]
[*]Dark Summon【Discard】
SP: Allows you to look at the top two cards of the selected player's graveyard and choose one.
[*]Greed【Discard】
SP: Draws an additional card.
[*]Oblivion【Discard】
SP: Discards the highest-cost card instead of the lowest-cost card.
[*]Revival【Discard】
SP: Allows the resurrection of a dead player. If the selected player's graveyard has 5 or more cards, they heal 2 HP instead.
[/list]
[b]【Sunrise】[/b]
[list]
[*]Assassin【Discard】
SP: Discards a random card instead of the lowest-cost card.
[*]Meditation【Discard】
SP: Draws an additional card.
[/list]
[b]【Named】[/b]
[list]
[*]Cheer【Discard】
SP: Increases Short Hand Advantage by +2.
[/list]
[b]【Horror】[/b]
[list]
[*]JumpScare【Discard】
SP: Also moves C cards on the field to the ruins.
[/list]
[*][h3]Skill "Finishing Blow" Revamped into "Challenge"[/h3]
The "Finishing Blow" skill has been reborn as the EX card-attached skill "Challenge"!
When the conditions are met, it transforms into a powerful EX card with the skill "Final Art," capable of instantly defeating a player.
[list]
[*][b]Challenge【Standard】[/b]
If this card remains in the Offense Zone until the owner's next turn, it returns to the hand and transforms into "FinalArt."
ULT: If the attack result is a draw, instead of the Short Hand shifting towards the opponent, this card remains permanently locked in the Offense Zone.
[*][b]FinalArt【Standard】[/b]
A desperate, all-in decisive strike.
Upon attacking, instantly defeats the opponent.
ULT: This card never loses.
[/list]
[*][h3]Game Performance Display Feature[/h3]
The bottom right corner of the screen now displays real-time game performance metrics such as frame rate, CPU usage, and network traffic.
[*][h3]New Battle BGM[/h3]
When playing with three or more players, additional variations of climax-phase BGM have been added.
[*][h3]New Battle Option for Enabling/Disabling Super Skills[/h3]
You can now choose whether to enable or disable the newly introduced Super Skills in battles.
By default, Super Skills are enabled.
[*][h3]Added Game Exit Button[/h3]
[*][h3]Added V-Sync On/Off Setting[/h3]
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]Skills[/h2]
[h3]【Basic】[/h3]
[list]
[*]Double Edged【Standard】
New: Deals 1 damage whenever the Short Hand moves in a favorable direction, but also takes 1 damage whenever it moves in an unfavorable direction.
However, damage can only be triggered up to twice per player.
New ULT: Removes the activation limit.
[*]Kick Out【Standard】
New Mechanic: Cannot be activated if the target card has the "Kick Away" skill.
[*]Return【Standard】
New: When this card successfully attacks, it is returned to the bottom of the deck.
New ULT: If this card's attack defeats a player, it returns to the hand instead.
[*]Reverse【Discard】
Category Change: Standard → Discard
New ULT: Heals all players by 1. Additionally, returns cards in the Offense Zone to their owner’s hand and immediately ends the turn.
[*]Surge【Standard】
New ULT: Increases the damage dealt to 2.
[/list]
[h3]【Advanced】[/h3]
[list]
[*]Choice【Standard】
Updated: When moving from the Defense Zone to the Offense Zone, choose a Future.
[strike]Choosing a Future no longer increases attack power by 1.[/strike]
Updated ULT: [strike]Future's attack power is no longer further increased by 1,[/strike] but the chosen Future now determines the effect.
[list]
[*]Future【Standard】
New: Heals 1 HP after attacking.
[*]Future (Alternative)【Standard】
New: Deals 1 additional damage after attacking.
[/list]
[*]Dark Summon【Discard】
New ULT: Allows the player to look at the top 3 cards of the selected player's graveyard and choose 1.
[*]Finishing Blow【Standard】
Reworked into Challenge (See "New Features & Additions" for details).
[*]Greed【Discard】
New: Draws 1 card.
New UR: Instead of drawing 1 card, draws a number of cards equal to the result of a dice roll.
[*]Trapper【Standard】
New: Before adding a new trap, returns all traps in hand to the deck.
[/list]
[h3]【Sunrise】[/h3]
[list]
[*]Assassination【Discard】
New: Sends the lowest-cost card from the selected player's hand to the Ruins.
[*]Meditation【Discard】
New: Returns all cards in hand to the deck, shuffles, and draws the same number of cards.
New ULT: Draws cards equal to the current hand size +1 first, then returns the original hand to the deck.
[*]Foresight【Standard】
New: Nullifies the Short Hand advantage/disadvantage effects and the absolute win/lose effects of the opposing card.
[*]Suppression【Standard】
New ULT: Activates regardless of rarity and is unaffected by zone locks and barriers.
[/list]
[h3]【Named】[/h3]
[list]
[*]Cheer【Discard】
New: During this turn, cards in the Defense Zone gain Short Hand Advantage (+1) in battles.
New ULT: If a card in the Defense Zone wins while this effect is active, this card returns to the hand.
[*]Sky High【Standard】
New: If this card results in a draw when attacking, it returns to the top of the deck.
New ULT: If this card would be sent to the graveyard from the deck due to damage, it is revealed and added to the hand instead.
[*]Trick or Treat【Standard】
New: At the start of the turn, forces the opponent to choose Trick or Treat.
 Trick!: Returns all cards in hand to the deck, shuffles, then draws until the hand reaches the standard size.
 Treat!: The opponent offers a chosen card from their hand to skip their turn.
New ULT:
 Trick!: If attacked by this card, the top card of the deck is stolen.
 Treat!: The opponent chooses which card to give up.
[*]Yin-Yang【Standard】
New ULT: If an attack lacks elemental or race compatibility, it is considered attack-favored. If it lacks size or method compatibility, it is considered defense-favored.
[/list]
[h3]【Horror】[/h3]
[list]
[*]Chaser【Standard】
New: At the end of the turn in which this card was played, the player's turn order is adjusted to be just before the chosen player.
New ULT: This effect activates at the end of every turn.

[*]Jump Scare【Discard】
New ULT: Now also affects R rarity cards. Additionally, moves all C and R rarity cards on the field to the Ruins.

[*]Patrifying Fear【GameChanger】
New: Reduces the standard number of cards drawn at the start of the turn by 1.
[/list]
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Disturbed rarity cards such as Poison, Curse, and Traps can no longer be placed directly into the Defense Zone or Offense Zone.
[*] The skill icons for Future and Future (Alternative) have been redesigned for better distinction.
[*] Improved translation accuracy for non-Japanese language settings.
[*] Deck files created in Ver. 0.16.1 or earlier are no longer supported and cannot be loaded.
[*] Rendering methods have been revised based on quality settings for a smoother gameplay experience.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[*]German
[*]Hebrew
[*]Spanish (Spain)
[*]French
[*]Italian
[*]Portuguese (Brazil)
[*]Russian
[*]Thai

The host will be able to eject room members at the touch of a button. However, the ejected member can re-enter the room.

If the time limit is exceeded, the cards to be played will be selected completely randomly.

In addition, as an AFK measure, the time limit for a player who has not clicked once during a turn will start at 10 seconds next turn.

Cards without skills are not eligible.
[/list]

[h2]Skill[/h2]
[h3]【Basic】[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]DoubleEdged[/h3]

New ULT：Means compatibility long hand movement +1
[*][h3]Return[/h3]
New：When this card successfully attacks, return this card to your hand.
However, it cannot be moved to the offense zone after defense, and is moved to the site.
[/list]
[h3]【Sunrise】[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Meditation[/h3]
New：Return all cards in hand to the deck, shuffle, and draw three cards.
[/list]
[h3]【Named】[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]SkyHigh[/h3]
New：When you lose or draw during an attack, roll the dice. If the roll is +2 or more than the attack power of the opponent's card, return this card to the top of the deck.
New ULT：The card is not activated by "attack power of the opponent's card + 2 or more," but by "attack power of the opponent's card + 1 or more."
[/list]
[h3]【Horror】[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]PetrifyingFear[/h3]
New：During combat, the long hand will not move to the defense side the first time.
[/list]

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted target frame rate when quality is "low
[*]Changed so that backups are not erased by forced cache deletion after update (limited to backups from Ver. 0.18.0 or later)
[*][FinishingBlow] changed from Basic Pack to Advanced Pack.
[*]Change backup storage location.
New：C:\Users\【UserName】\AppData\LocalLow\GasaiGames\MonsterCards\Temporary\Backup
Old：C:\Users\【UserName】\AppData\LocalLow\GasaiGames\MonsterCards\Temporary
[*]Changed the position of the Delete Cache button.
[*]Added a button to jump to the patch note page at the position of the delete cache button.
[*]The status of the room will now indicate that the deck is loading.
[*]Changed to return to blank when all erase is done on layer 3.
[*]Removed the skipping of a match when the short hand swings out during combat.
[*]When a card is changed by an effect such as "Choice" or "Wild Element" while "InTheDark" is in effect, the darkness is re-applied to the card after the change.
[*]Changed the specification so that if a player dies, such as from damage sustained while attempting to replace an offense zone, the replacement will not take place.
[/list]

Discard a card from the selected player's hand at random to the Ruins.
ULT：You will be able to choose one card by looking at your opponent's hand instead of randomly.
[*][h3]Bushido (Standard)[/h3]
When this card moves into the Offense Zone, it locks the Offense Zone for the next turn.
ULT：Additional game changer zones and ruins will also be locked.
[*][h3]Divine Nullification (GameChanger)[/h3]
Any skill effects will not be activated.
ULT：Lock the GameChanger zone for the next three turns.
[*][h3]Meditation (Discard)[/h3]
Return all the cards in hand to the deck, shuffle them, and start the turn over.
ULT：Cards with a Rarity of Disturbed are not returned to the deck, but discarded to Ruins.
[*][h3]Mind's Eye (Standard)[/h3]
Negates the short-hand advantage/disadvantage effect of the card confronted.
ULT：Double the short-hand advantage/disadvantage effect that this card receives.
[*][h3]Suppression (Standard)[/h3]
The game changer of this card's rarity or lower is dismissed.
ULT：Activates regardless of rarity and is not affected by zone lock.

It is now possible to switch the card selection tool from the game settings. The default setting is Explorer.

The created card image can be output in three different patterns from the Card Settings panel (Flavor Text Settings screen)!

Players will be able to choose the team they belong to in the room.

[list]

All cards will change to a random skill at the start of the match. In very rare cases, they may change into EX skills such as poison or perfection...?
[*]Auto Target
Skills such as Snipe and Dark Summon will automatically select the player. However, if you are available for selection, you will be given priority.
[*]Automatic team assignment
All players' teams are automatically assigned at the start of the match. Players who have already manually selected their teams will be reassigned.

Apply ULT to all card skills.

[*]E：eraser
[*]I：eye-dropper
[*]B：bucket
[*]Right-click and hold: eye-dropper

[*]2：Switch to Layer 2
[*]3：Switch to Layer 3

A notification button will appear on the title screen when there is a message from the management, such as the discovery of a critical bug or a server maintenance notice.

[*][h3]Additional types of awards[/h3]
[/list]

[h2]Match-up[/h2]
[h3]Species[/h3]
The chemistry between the machines went from a defense advantage to a draw.

[*][h3]Finishing Blow[/h3]
New：When this card is in the offense zone, it gains the following effects
・ Gain short-hand disadvantage (-4).
・ If the owner of this card has zero cards in his hand, he attacks with the strongest means.
・ If the attack is successful, the opponent is killed instantly.

[*][h3]Friendship[/h3]
New ULT：It is activated regardless of rarity and zone lock.

New ULT：Healing amount to 2
[/list]
[h3]Advanced[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Evolve[/h3]
Specification change：Changed the status of the complete body to increase in rarity by 1 level, increase in attack power by 2, and changeable type.
New ULT：The attack power of the final form is further enhanced by 2.
[*][h3]Final Form[/h3]
New ULT：No effect
[*][h3]Oblivion[/h3]
Specification change：Changed so that it does not apply to players who have died
[/list]

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changed title screen illustration
[*]New EX Card setup method
[*]EX Cards are now saved as single card files
[*]Removed the limit on the number of EX Card type rerolls
[*]Import of card illustrations is now possible for both non-EX and EX cards
[*]New card frame visuals
[*]Changed card sizes
[*]Added markers to EX cards
[*]Changed the BGM icon on cards with BGM not to be displayed
[*]Removed restrictions on cards created during the open beta
[*]Supported localization of skill and type names
[*]Revised overall conditions for achievement of commendations
[*]Reduction of load during a match (medium and low quality)
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/3159db50d021140f8057cde307772968ac580190.png[/img]
[b][h1]Introduction[/h1][/b]
Thank you for always enjoying MONSTER CARDS!
We are very happy to see that the game is becoming more and more exciting with user-sponsored tournaments being held!

Now, on this page, we would like to inform you about MONSTER CARDS Ver0.16.0!
Last time, the newly added Ultimate Skills added more color to the game, but at the same time, some of them were so powerful that they caused a lot of damage to the competitive environment.

In this patch, we have reviewed the effects of Ultimate Skills once again and adjusted the game balance so that as many skills as possible can be used.
In particular, we have also reviewed the cost, which has a significant impact on deck construction, so please check it out!

For more detailed information, please click the link below. (Japanese only)
[url=https://gasai.dev/ec150017d3524729841d2eacc6d2e9bc]MONSTER CARDS Ver.0.16.0 パッチノート[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/8aecff2efc709dad8267420517f0dfb601c72ca4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/1b50d4129d1bc64fba702d348b3686550dfd0858.png[/img]

[h1]New Features and Elements[/h1]
[list]
[*][h3]Addition of new skills (2 types) to the Advanced (formerly Extra) pack[/h3]
[list]
[*][h3]Parry (Standard)[/h3]
If this card defends, the short hand is fixed in the center. However, only positions that would normally be considered a draw are considered a win; all other positions are considered a loss.
ULT: 3 damage to the opponent if successfully defended.
[*][h3]Oblivion (Discard)[/h3]
All players, including yourself, discard the lowest cost card from your hand to the cemetery.
ULT: Discard all cards.
[/list]
[*][h3]Additional sample cards and decks[/h3]
Three cards each of UR, SR, R, and C will be available immediately after the game is installed.
Please check the SANPLE folder. (There are two versions, Japanese and English)

[*][h3]Card Award Function[/h3]
Cards that perform well during the match will be awarded on the results screen. There will be more than 20 types of awards!
We are also accepting requests for awards that you would like to see added in the future.

[*][h3]Rework of match result prediction[/h3]
The compatibility of attributes, species, size, and means is now shown at a glance. Instead, WIN and LOSE are not displayed.
Note that, as before, effects that change parameters before the match, such as ElementalTorrent, are not taken into account.

[*][h3]Battle log display function[/h3]
The game flow will be transcribed and displayed. The display can be changed in the settings. (hidden by default).

[*][h3]New " Skill Hide " matchmaking option[/h3]
During a match, the skill icons and skill information on the cards are hidden. This setting is for advanced players who are no longer satisfied with the normal way of playing, and the cost is also hidden to provide a hint for guessing.

[*][h3]Add a bucket tool[/h3]

[*][h3]Completion preview added to the Paint screen[/h3]

[*][h3]Option to play or not to play card BGM during a match.[/h3]

[*][h3]Stage BGM changes when a match reaches its climax.[/h3]

[*][h3]Supports cloud saving[/h3]
Only player data is saved to the cloud, not card data.
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance Adjustment[/h1]
[h2]Costs[/h2]
[h3]Rarity[/h3]
C：6 → [b]5[/b]
R：7 → [b]6[/b]
SR：9 → [b]8[/b]
UR：12 → 12 (No change)
 
[h3]Skill[/h3]
None：0 → 0 (No change)
Standard：1 → [b]2[/b]
Discard：2 → [b]1[/b]
GameChanger：4 → 4 (No change)

[h2]Match up[/h2]
[h3]Element[/h3]
Light and Dark each have the same genus and defense advantage.

[h3]Species[/h3]
The matchups for Elemental, Dragon, God, Devil, Machine, and Ghost have been significantly revised.
For more information, please see the patch notes on the official Wiki.

[h3]Means[/h3]
Special and Guard were tied at the same means.　

[h2]Skill[/h2]
Many Ultimate Skills have been adjusted to reduce the variation in strength.


[h3]【BASIC】[/h3][list]
[*][h3]Dodge[/h3]
New: immediately ends the turn and avoids attacks of cards with attack strength of 2 or less
NewULT: Avoids attacks of all cards, regardless of attack power

[*][h3]Friendship (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Activated regardless of rarity.

[*][h3]FinishingBlow[/h3]
New: An attack after the long hand has moved in the direction favorable to this card four times will kill the player immediately. If the owner of this card is dying, this card in the offense zone cannot be directly replaced.
NewULT: If dying, attack by the strongest means.

[*][h3]GiantKilling (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Must win if attack power is 2 or more than this card

[*][h3]Pressure (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Damage the owner of the game changer as well, and if each card has 1 attack or less, send it in the ruins.

[*][h3]Protection (Specification change・ULT)[/h3]
Specification change: The effect activation timing is changed from when the defense is defeated to before the battle as a defense.
NewULT: Can now nullify any damage until end of turn, and also activates at the beginning of the turn when in the offense zone.

[*][h3]Reverse (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: All players get all stolen cards back from their hands.

[*][h3]Ruin (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Attack damage and discard hand effects will now move cards from the deck to the ruins.

[*][h3]Snipe (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Can select the target twice.

[*][h3]Surge (ULT)[/h3]
New ULT: The effect is re-activated with each successful attack.

[/list]
[h3]【ADVANCED】[/h3][list]
[*][h3]DarkSummon (ULT)[/h3]
New ULT: Add it to your hand instead of putting it in the defense zone.

[*][h3]Fascinate[/h3]
NEW: When a card is played, the owner of the card in the offense zone rolls the dice, and if he rolls a 1, he takes a random hand card and puts it into his hand.
NewULT: All other players also roll dice.

[*][h3]Greed (ULT)[/h3]
NewULT: Draw two more cards.

[*][h3]Poisoner (ULT)[/h3]
New ULT: Gives one if the attack fails.

[*][h3]Poison[/h3]
New: Take 1 damage and draw 1 card. If the top card in the ruins is a poison card, the damage taken is 2.
[/list]

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved image quality of downloaded cards
[*]Changed the name of Extra packs to Advanced packs
[*]Changed the number of rerolls to 12 when creating cards
[*]Changed so that there are no duplicates in rarity rerolls.
[*]Changed the probability of the attack power drawing when creating cards.
[*]Changed so that card file names can now use non-alphanumeric characters by default.
[*]Changed options for beginners.
[*]CPU enhancements
[*]Added reconnection attempt process
[*]Changed so that attacks do not occur after a player has been eliminated.
[*]Adjusted post-effects at quality "high" (high load)
[/list]

[list]
[*]C:/Users/[username]/AppData/LocalLow/GasaiGames/MonsterCards/Temporary
[/list]
*Backups are deleted when card editing is successfully completed and by cache deletion, so be sure to restore them as soon as possible.
[*]Added duplicate card button, card cost, and total cost notations on deck organization screen
[*]Ability to specify where to save files when creating cards
[*]Ability to set master BGM volume, stage BGM volume, and card BGM volume separately
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance Adjustment[/h1]

[h2]Skill[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Friendship[/h3]
Added an activation condition because it was too good as a stable means of removing cards in the offense zone.
New Effects：When this card is placed in the defense zone, if it matches the rarity of the card in the offense zone, move both cards to the ruins and start the turn over again.
[*][h3]FinishingBlow[/h3]
Significantly strengthened because of its overly difficult-to-use performance.
New Effects：This card always gains short-hand disadvantage (-2), but the player attacked by this card dies immediately.
[*][h3]Snipe[/h3]
Reworked to a more practical effect, closer to the image associated with the skill name and icon.
New Effects：Specify a player and deal 1 damage.
[*][h3]DoubleEdged：諸刃[/h3]
Specification Change：Damage determination changed to take into account the amount of movement of long needles such as GiantKilling.
[/list]

[h1]About Card Costs[/h1]
Card Cost is an indicator of card strength introduced in this patch.
Card costs are automatically calculated from card parameters and are used mainly when making up decks.
 
They are calculated as follows
 
[u][b]Formula: Cost = Rarity + Attack Power + Skill[/b][/u]

[h3]Rarity [/h3]
C：6
R：7
SR：9
UR：12
※D：0
 
[h3]Attack Power[/h3]
1：0
2：1
3：2
4：3
5：4
 
[h3]Skill[/h3]
None：0
Standard：1
Discard：2
GameChanger：4

For example...
If the card is Rarity C, Attack 1, no skill, then the card will cost 6+0+0 for a cost of 6. (minimum cost)
If the card is Rarity UR, Attack 5, GameChanger skill (e.g. Revolution), then the card will cost 12+4+4 for a cost of 20. (Maximum Cost)

[*]Changed so that non-hosts can also check match options.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42477772/5a13ad41d944c13412a192c4553c321f84e5bd70.png[/img]
Thank you for playing MONSTER CARDS!
It's been two months since we started Early Access, and there are many people who are excited about this game on video streaming sites and in the Steam community, which always encourages us in our development.

For more detailed information, please click the link below. (Japanese only)
[url=https://gasai.dev/543e0af745734bcd8247724460f568fa]MONSTER CARDS Ver.0.14.0 パッチノート[/url]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ability to set flavor text (up to 300 characters)
[*]Display compatibility table, skill effects, and flavor text when cards are expanded
[*]Automatic organization of ruins
[*]Added direction to the player's panel when his/her card is on the field
[*]Avatar motion and panel direction added when player is dying
[*]Show confirmation dialog before discarding card edits
[*]New matchup options "random order" and "chaotic compatibility"
[/list]

[h1]Game Balance Adjustments[/h1]

[h2]Match-up[/h2]
[h3]Element/h3]
Adjusted so that the superiority of each element is almost eliminated
[h3]Species[/h3]
Adjustment of each species to have obvious characteristics
Human：The long hand always moves. Standard strength
Beast：Less susceptible to the strengths of dragons and elementals.
Sea：Standard strength, even with God and a must win against the devil.
Elemental：The most defensive species. They are not good at attacking.
Dragon：The most attack-focused species. Not good at defense.
God：The strongest species with few unfavorable face-to-face encounters and excellent offensive and defensive capabilities.
Devil：Above standard strength. The only one that can take advantage of God when attacking, except for insects.
Machine：Above standard strength. Defenders can take advantage of the only god except insects.
Insect：The weakest race with the most disadvantageous opponents. However, they will always have an advantage over the stronger species, the gods and elementals.
Ghost：The species with the longest needle is the most difficult to move. You can always take advantage of people.
[h3]Size[/h3]
No change
[h3]Means[/h3]
Special to Guard-specific offensive measures

[h2]Skill[/h2]
[h3]FinishingBlow[/h3]
Renewed skill effects.
[h3]Reverse[/h3]
Changed the category of the skill from GameChanger to Standard so that the effect is permanent.
[h3]ElementalTorrent[/h3]
Skill effects were complex, so they were redesigned to make it easier for decks with a single attribute to benefit from them.
[h3]GiantKilling[/h3]
To make the effect simpler, it is changed so that it is triggered if the attack power is at least 1, not 2 or more.
[h3]Friendship[/h3]
Changed so that it is not triggered when the Offense Zone cannot be directly replaced, such as by the effect of a skill.

[h1]Important Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed the number of decks" in the Matchup Options changed to "Fixed the number of decks to 20 decks".
[*]Changed the "Cards Jumbled" match option to equalize the number of decks for each player.
[*]Limit the number of music files that can be added to a card to mp3 only (wave is no longer supported).
[*]Newly created cards are given the creator's nickname information.
[*]Remove card ID function
[*]Enter file name instead of ID when creating a card (one-byte alphanumeric characters only)  
[*]Specification changes and encryption of deck files
[*]Changed so that when trying to save a deck file with the same name, instead of creating an alias file, the file is overwritten with a confirmation.
[*]Time until timeout extended (from 3 minutes to 30 minutes)
[*]Changed to check the integrity of one's deck after pressing the ready button in the room and before sending it to the server
[/list]
